device.name: PrusaLink (Prusa MK4 / MK3.9 / XL / Mini)
device.notes:
PrusaLink is Prusa's on-printer web server (MK4, MK3.9, XL, Mini) with a published OpenAPI spec. Local HTTP on the printer's LAN IP, no cloud. AUTH is HTTP Digest (username `maker` + the printer's password/PIN) and/or an X-Api-Key header. A legacy OctoPrint-compatible /api/ surface exists for older clients.
ENDPOINTS:
  GET  /api/version                    API + firmware version
  GET  /api/v1/info                     device info
  GET  /api/v1/status                   real-time printer/job/transfer/storage/
                                        camera telemetry
  GET  /api/v1/job                      current job
  PUT  /api/v1/job/{id}/pause | /resume | /continue
  DELETE /api/v1/job/{id}               stop
  PUT  /api/v1/files/{storage}/{path}   upload G-code
  POST /api/v1/files/{storage}/{path}   start a print of an uploaded file
  HEAD /api/v1/files/{storage}/{path}   check presence
  DELETE /api/v1/files/{storage}/{path} remove

openness.notes: Vendor-provided and documented (open OpenAPI spec; the firmware itself is GPL). Upstream is authoritative.

methods.description: Enable PrusaLink in the printer network settings, note the IP and API key/password from the screen, then call /api/v1 over HTTP Digest (maker + password) or with the X-Api-Key header.

steps.action: Enable PrusaLink in the printer network settings; read the IP and API key/password.
Call GET /api/v1/status (Digest maker + password, or X-Api-Key).

setup.notes: Enable PrusaLink in the printer's network settings; the screen shows the API key/password and IP. Connect with `maker` + password (Digest) or the API key header. No cloud.

rejoin.notes: Network settings are changed from the printer menu while reachable.

testing.notes: Not driven against hardware by this project. The endpoints and auth are from Prusa's own PrusaLink OpenAPI spec.
